overview.text: Elected to the Three Valleys board in 2022, Jeff Hanlon resigned in June 2026 to seek a district job he did not get. He teaches political science at Whittier College and holds a public policy doctorate. His priorities are water capture and storage, infrastructure reinvestment, and the Pure Water Southern California recycling program. In 2022, he opposed the Cadiz water project and pushed for a climate change action plan.
